summary: A lot broke at once. Democrats swept Congress in the midterms, and the market read it two ways at the same time. First, oil. Brent plunged more than 8% in a single session to a near two month low, because a Democratic Congress raises the odds of a deal with Iran. Brent is $97 and crude is $90, down from $117 and $103 two weeks ago. Second, AI. Investors are cutting tech exposure over what that same Congress means for AI and data centre spending. Equities sold off and money ran to treasuries. So the two things I have been writing about all fall just reversed together, from one election. Look at the curve. The 10 year is *4.83%*, a two month low, and the 2 year is 4.49%, down 31bp in a month. Remember when the 10 year was 5.35% and I said the long end was not trading on inflation? This is the proof. Oil collapsed and yields fell anyway. Both times the answer was risk, not prices. And the Fed held on 28 Oct, two voted to hike. Markets now say 75% chance of a hike in December. Mixing this all in a pot: GDP at 3.4%, jobless claims at a 57 year low, inflation still elevated, and the Fed getting ready to hike into an equity selloff. Payrolls tomorrow.
_fedPath_note: Every FOMC decision since the last hike, oldest first: the date, the upper bound of the target range after it, and hike / cut / hold. Drawn as the staircase under the Fed and listed in its card. Add a row after each meeting.

news.what: Equity selloff and a flight to safety. Investors cutting tech exposure over what a Democratic Congress means for AI and data centre spending. 10 year at a two month low.
Brent plunged more than 8% in a session to a near two month low, on hopes the midterm result improves the odds of a deal with Iran.
Democrats swept Congress in the midterms. The 10 year fell about 8bp on the result.
Q3 GDP came in at 3.4% annualised, up from 2.2% in Q2.
Fed held at 3.75-4.00%. Two policymakers voted to hike. Warsh said the Fed will cut the number of voting meetings starting in 2027.
Brent hit $117, the highest since June 2022, on expectations the US resumes strikes on Iran.

_oil_note: Optional daily override. Set asOf to the date you read them and fill wti/brent. Used only while newer than FRED's print - if you stop updating, it falls back to FRED automatically rather than showing an ever-staler number.
_curve_note: Optional hand entry for a yield FRED has not published yet. Same rule as oil: only used while newer than FRED. notes/alert are display only. Put alert on whatever the day's story is: it turns the figure rust and is the only thing telling a first-time visitor where to look. strain is the quieter version: a smaller crack on the summit, number stays in ink. track is [open, low, now] for one tenor's day, drawn as a path under the summit; use it only when the path matters more than the close, and leave it out otherwise.
